DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのような散歩をご予定ですか。ご一緒の方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of walk are you planning today? Is anyone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と犬を連れて少し歩きたいです。この地図の休憩室まで行き、犬も一緒に中で休めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と犬との短い散歩で、地図の休憩室に犬も入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a short walk with a friend and a dog. Can we go to this rest lounge on the map and rest inside with the dog too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the dog may enter the mapped rest lounge during a short walk with a friend and dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この休憩室の室内は犬と一緒には利用できません。屋外のベンチなら、一緒に休める場所をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dogs cannot use the indoor part of this rest lounge. I can show outdoor benches where you can rest together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、外で休む案にします。ただ、自分だけ室内を利用したいとき、案内所で犬を預かってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋外休憩へ変え、自分だけ室内利用するとき案内所に犬を預けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we will rest outside. But if I want to use indoors alone, could the information office look after the dog?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Change to an outdoor rest and ask whether the office can care for the dog while you use indoors alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 犬のお預かりは行っていません。同行者の方にお願いできるか、先にご相談ください。犬をつないだまま離れることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We do not look after dogs. First ask whether your companion can do so. Do not leave the dog tied up and walk away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が見ていられるか聞きます。無理なら室内には入らず、二人と犬で外の短い道を往復したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人が犬の世話をできるか確認し、無理なら室内へ入らず二人と犬で短い往復にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask whether my friend can watch it. If not, I will not go indoors; the two of us and the dog will take a short out-and-back outdoors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether your friend can care for the dog; if not, stay outside and take a short return walk as two people with the dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この舗装された道と手前のベンチをご案内します。犬を連れたまま通れる表示の範囲をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show this paved path and the nearer bench. Check the signs for the area you may pass through with a dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 短い道でも、どこへでも犬を連れて行けるわけではないのですね。地図で通れる範囲を示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 犬同伴の通行範囲が限られると確認し、地図上で示してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even on a short path, I cannot take the dog just anywhere. Could you show the permitted area on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the dog-accessible area is limited and ask to have it shown on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの線で囲んだ範囲です。犬を放さず、表示のない先へ自己判断で進まないでください。友人の方にも地図をお見せになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Within this outlined area. Do not let the dog loose or proceed beyond signs on your own judgment. Will you show the map to your friend too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、友人と通れる範囲と屋外ベンチを確認します。犬を預けられると決めつけず、二人で世話をできる範囲で散歩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人と範囲と屋外ベンチを確認し、預かりを当然とせず二人で世話できる範囲で歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, we will check the permitted area and outdoor bench together. I will not assume dog care is available; we will walk where we can care for it ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the area and outdoor bench with your friend, do not assume dog care, and walk within your joint ability to care for it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この地図をお持ちください。休憩室の条件と屋外の利用範囲を確認して、短い散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this map. Check the rest lounge's conditions and outdoor-use area, and enjoy a short walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と合わせて切符をお探しでしょうか。どのような席をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a ticket to coordinate with your companion? What kind of seat would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に予約した友人と同じ車両にしたいです。同じ車両の切符を買えば、隣に座れると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が予約済みで、同じ車両を選べば隣になると思っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want the same carriage as my friend who booked earlier. I think buying a ticket for the same carriage lets me sit next to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your friend has booked and you think choosing the same carriage means sitting next to them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ車両でも、隣の席とは限りません。ご友人の座席の番号まで分かるものはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The same carriage does not necessarily mean adjacent seats. Do you have something showing your friend's seat number too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送ってもらった画像には車両の番号しか写っていません。座席の部分が切れているので、もう一度友人に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像は車両番号だけで座席部分が切れているため、友人へ詳細を聞き直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The image they sent only shows the carriage number. The seat part is cut off, so I will ask my friend again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the image only shows carriage number with seat details cropped, so you will ask your friend again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 座席が分かったら、その位置とご自身の希望を照らし合わせましょう。隣の席を選べない場合、ほかに優先したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once the seat is known, compare that location with your wishes. If an adjacent seat cannot be chosen, do you have another priority?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣がなければ、同じ車両の通路側を優先したいです。窓の近くより、席を立ちやすい方を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣がなければ同じ車両の通路側を優先し、窓より席を立ちやすい方を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: If none beside them, prioritize an aisle seat in the same carriage. I would prefer easy access to leave my seat rather than being near a window.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: If no adjacent seat, prioritize same-carriage aisle and easier movement over window proximity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路側をご希望ですね。どの席が選べるかは、対象の列車の確認が必要です。ご友人から詳しい情報は届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: An aisle seat, then. We need to check the specific train to know what can be chosen. Has your friend's detailed information arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座席まで入った画像が来ました。こちらです。友人の隣が選べるかと、難しい場合の通路側を順に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座席入りの画像を示し、隣の席の可否と難しい場合の通路側を順に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: An image including the seat arrived. Here it is. I want to ask first whether a seat beside my friend is available, then an aisle seat if not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the seat-inclusive image and ask in order about adjacent seating and an aisle alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順序で候補を確認します。今の画像だけで、ご自身の席も確保されたわけではないので、ご案内後にお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check options in that order. This image alone does not secure a seat for you, so choose after we explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 候補を見てから選びます。同じ車両という条件だけで隣と決めず、友人の席との位置と自分の席の種類を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補を見て選び、同じ車両だけで隣と決めず位置と席の種類を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose after seeing options. I will not infer adjacency just from the same carriage; I will check the position relative to my friend's seat and my own seat type.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose after seeing options, do not assume adjacency from carriage alone, and check relative position and seat type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人の位置関係を確認する相談として承ります。画像をこちらでお見せいただき、対象の列車と席の候補を一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will handle this as advice on the two seats' relationship. Show the image here and let us check the train and seat options together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知に添えられた用紙をお持ちですね。印刷されている所でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the form attached to a notice. Is there a problem with the printed section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙に知らない人の名前が入っています。私に届いた通知なのに、ここを消して自分の名前に直すのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人宛て通知の用紙に知らない名前があり、消して自分の名へ直すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This paper has a stranger's name. The notice came to me, but I do not know whether to erase it and change it to my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the form in your notice has an unknown name and ask whether to erase and replace it with your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上に記入例という見出しがありますね。ほかに、まだ何も記入されていない用紙も入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The heading above says example of completion. Was there also an unfilled form enclosed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの白い用紙もありました。名前がある方は書き方の見本で、私がその人の名前を写す物ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白い用紙を示し、名前入りは記入見本でその名前を写す物ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This blank white form too. The named one is a writing sample, not something whose person's name I should copy, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the blank form and confirm the named one is a sample, not a name to copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本と、記入する用紙を分けてご覧ください。ご本人の情報を書く前に、意味を確かめたい欄はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Look at the sample separately from the form to complete. Before writing your own details, is any field's meaning unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この続柄という欄です。見本の答えをそのまま使わず、自分の場合に何を説明する欄か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 続柄の意味を尋ね、見本の回答でなく本人の場合に説明する内容を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This relationship field. Rather than use the sample's answer, I want to ask what it is asking me to explain in my case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what the relationship field means and what to explain in your case rather than use the sample answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その欄は担当がご本人の状況を伺って説明します。添付する物についても、通知の案内と照合するご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will hear your situation and explain that field. Would you also like the attachments checked against the notice's guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。見本に紙の名前が並んでいるだけで、全部が私に必要とは分からないので、添付する物も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本の書類一覧が全て本人に必要とは不明なため、添付する物を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. A list of document names in the sample does not tell me all are necessary for me, so I want attachments checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the sample's full document list is not necessarily all needed for you and request attachment checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な欄と添付物の二点を担当へお伝えください。期限の表示も、通知をお持ちのまま確認していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell staff those two points: unclear field and attachments. With the notice in hand, you can check the deadline display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知、記入例、白い用紙を分けてお見せします。名前を書き写したり、分からない欄を見本の答えで埋めたりせず、担当に質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知・記入例・白い用紙を分け、名前や不明欄を写さず記入前に担当へ質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the notice, example and blank form separately. I will ask staff rather than copy the name or fill unclear fields with sample answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate notice, example and blank form, and ask staff before writing rather than copy names or unclear-field answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙の違いを整理できましたね。こちらの担当に、記入前のご質問としてお話しください。通知の期限も一緒にご確認いただけるようおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have sorted the different papers. Speak to this staff member with your pre-completion questions. We will connect you so the notice deadline can be checked too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受診歴の欄を見ていらっしゃいますね。ご記入で迷う所がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at consultation history. Is any part difficult to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここは初めてですが、同じ手首の痛みで別の所にかかっています。初めてと書くと、前の受診がなかったことになる気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当施設は初めてだが同じ手首で他施設を受診済みで、初めて欄に迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first time here, but I went elsewhere for the same wrist pain. Writing first time feels as if the earlier visit never happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it is your first time here but you consulted elsewhere for the same wrist, so you are unsure about the first-time field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は当院での受診が初めてかを尋ねています。ほかで受診したことは、症状の経過と分けて伺いましょう。痛みに気づいたのはいつごろでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field asks whether it is your first visit to this hospital. We will ask about previous care elsewhere separately from symptom history. When did you notice the pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二週間ほど前、荷物を運んだ後に右手首が痛むと気づきました。別の所へ行ったのは先週で、痛みの始まりとは別の日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二週間前の荷物運搬後に右手首の痛みに気づき、他施設受診は先週だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About two weeks ago, after carrying luggage, I noticed right wrist pain. I went elsewhere last week, on a different day from the pain's beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain noticing right-wrist pain after carrying luggage two weeks ago and visiting another facility last week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状に気づいた時と、前の受診日を分けて記入しましょう。前の説明や薬について分かる資料はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write symptom-noticing time and previous consultation date separately. Do you have information about the earlier explanation or medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の施設でもらった紙を持っています。ただ、略した言葉があって、説明の内容を自分では正確に読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前の紙を持参したが略語を正確に読めず、説明内容を自己判断できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought the paper from the previous facility. But it has abbreviations, and I cannot accurately read the explanation myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you brought the previous paper but cannot accurately read abbreviations or judge its explanation yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めない所を別の言葉に決めつけず、紙のまま医師へお見せください。今の痛みについて、伝えておきたい違いもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the paper unchanged to the doctor without deciding unreadable parts mean other words. Is there any difference in current pain you want to convey too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右手首という場所は同じですが、前の診察と全く同じ状態かはうまく言えません。そのまま分からないと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所は右手首で同じだが前回と完全に同じ状態かは言いにくく、不明のまま伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the same location, right wrist, but I cannot express well whether the condition is exactly the same as at the last visit. I want to say honestly I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the right-wrist location is the same but exact sameness with the previous condition is hard to express, so you want to leave it unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 比較しにくいことも含めてお伝えしましょう。こちらで初めてという記入と、以前の資料を持参したことを一緒に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Convey the difficulty comparing too. We will pass on both your first visit here and bringing previous material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここへの初回来訪、二週間前の痛み、先週の他院受診を分けて書きます。前の紙は自分で言い換えずにお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初回来訪・症状開始・他院受診を分けて記入し、前の紙は言い換えず医師へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write separately: first visit here, pain two weeks ago, another hospital last week. I will hand over the old paper without rewording it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write first visit, symptom onset and other-hospital visit separately, and give the doctor the previous paper without paraphrasing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三つの時点と資料を整理できましたね。問診票と前の紙を合わせて医師へ引き継ぎますので、こちらで記入を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The three time points and material are organized. We will pass the questionnaire and previous paper together to the doctor, so let us check your entries here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帽子をお持ちですね。拾った品のご相談でしたら、まず経緯をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a hat. If this concerns a found item, tell me the circumstances first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園にあった帽子を届けに来ました。誰も近くにいませんでしたが、いらなくて置いた物かどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人が近くにいない公園の帽子を届け、持主が不要として置いたかは不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a hat found in the park. No one was nearby, but I do not know whether its owner left it because it was unwanted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought a park hat with no one nearby and do not know whether the owner deliberately discarded it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持主の意図は分からないということですね。拾った場所を示せる物や、覚えている目印はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the owner's intention is unknown. Any material showing the place or a landmark you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真のベンチだと思いましたが、よく見ると休憩した時の写真です。帽子を拾ったのは、その前に通った場所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ写真は後の休憩時で、発見場所はそれ以前の別地点だったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought this bench photo showed it, but looking closely, it is from my later rest. I found the hat somewhere I passed earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that the bench photo was from a later rest, while the finding location was another earlier point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩場所の写真と、拾った場所を分けて伺います。歩いた順序をたどると、どの辺りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will separate the rest-location photo from the finding location. Following the order you walked, where was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口から水飲み場を過ぎた所で、地面にありました。その後で写真のベンチへ行ったので、二か所を混ぜていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口から水飲み場を過ぎた地面で拾い、その後写真のベンチへ進んだ順序を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the ground after passing the drinking fountain from the entrance. I went to the photographed bench afterward, so I mixed up the two places.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain finding it on the ground beyond the fountain from the entrance, then going to the photographed bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水飲み場を過ぎた所で拾い、その後ベンチで休んだという順序ですね。時刻については、拾った時を正確に覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You found it beyond the fountain, then rested at the bench. Do you remember the exact finding time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正確な時刻は見ていません。写真の時刻より前だったとは分かりますが、写真の時刻をそのまま発見時刻にはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正確な時刻は不明で写真より前とだけ分かり、写真時刻を発見時刻にしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not check the exact time. I know it was before the photo, but cannot use the photo's time as the finding time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the exact time is unknown, only before the photo, and do not use photo time as finding time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲の記憶として確認します。帽子を手に取ってから、ほかの人へ渡したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm that limited memory. After picking up the hat, did you give it to anyone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 渡していません。自分で持ってここへ来ました。休憩の写真は場所そのものの証拠ではなく、順序を思い出すために使ったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他人へ渡さず持参し、写真は発見場所の証拠でなく順序を思い出す手掛かりだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I brought it here myself. I will explain the rest photo is a clue to remembering order, not proof of the actual finding place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you brought it without giving it to anyone, and the photo helps recall order rather than proves the finding place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真との関係と、持参までの経緯を合わせて担当へお伝えします。こちらで帽子とご説明の内容を確認していきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will tell staff both the photo's relationship and circumstances up to bringing it in. Let us check the hat and your account here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に伴う郵便のご相談ですね。今お住まいの状況から伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mail associated with moving, then. Could we start with your present living situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の家は出ましたが、新居に入るまで仮の宿に泊まっています。新居の住所が分かるので、そこへすぐ郵便を送る相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧居を出て入居まで仮宿におり、新居住所は分かるためすぐそこへ郵便を送る相談をしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left the old home but am in temporary lodging until entering the new one. I know the new address and want to ask about sending mail there immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left the old home and are in temporary lodging until moving in, know the new address and want mail sent there now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新居では、もう郵便を受け取れる状態でしょうか。住所が決まったことと、受け取れる状況は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the new home ready to receive mail already? Distinguish having an address decided from being able to receive there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ鍵を受け取っていません。入居は来月の予定で、その前に郵便を受け取れるかは聞いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵は未受領で入居予定は来月、その前の郵便受取りは未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not received the key. Move-in is planned next month, and I did not ask whether mail can be received before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the key has not been received, move-in is next month, and earlier mail receipt is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、現在の宿泊先と、入居予定の新居を別に伺います。宿泊先での受取りについては、何か確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will ask separately about current lodging and the planned new home. Have you checked anything about receiving at the lodging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宿にも聞いていません。今いる所を新住所と同じように書けばよいとも決められないので、二つの事情を分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仮宿にも受取条件を聞いておらず、同じ新住所として扱えると決めず状況を分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not asked them either. I cannot decide that writing where I am now as the new address is fine, so I will discuss the two situations separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say temporary-lodging receipt is unchecked too, and separate situations without deciding it can be treated as the same new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取状況は各相手にも確かめてください。手続きの相談用に、旧住所と新居の入居予定をメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check receipt conditions with each party too. Can you note the old address and planned move-in for the procedure inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旧住所、今の宿泊先、新居を別の行に書きます。鍵の受取りと入居の日が決まっていない所は、未確認と記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧居・仮宿・新居を別行にし、鍵の受取りや入居日の未確定部分を未確認と記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put old home, present lodging and new home on separate lines. I will mark unconfirmed any undecided key receipt or move-in date details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write old home, temporary lodging and new home on separate lines, marking undecided key receipt or move-in dates unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモで担当にご希望をお話しください。いつからどこへという希望と、実際に利用できる条件は確認を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use that note to tell staff your wishes. Separate when-and-where preferences from checks of actually usable conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今すぐ新居で受け取れると思わず、受取状況と利用条件を先に聞きます。宿への確認と、新居の担当者への確認も別に行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新居で直ちに受け取れると考えず、宿と新居担当への確認と利用条件の相談を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about receipt situations and usage conditions first, without assuming immediate new-home receipt. I will also check lodging and the new home's contact separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume immediate new-home receipt; separate lodging and new-home contact checks and consultation on usage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三つの場所と未確認の点が整理できましたね。こちらでメモをお見せいただき、担当へ転居前後のご相談をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The three places and unknown points are organized. Show the note here and continue discussing the move's before-and-after arrangements with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所と連絡先の変更をお考えですね。手元のメモには、どの番号を書かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are considering changing address and contact details. Which number is on your note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新住所と電話番号を書きました。この四けたは会社で使う内線なので、連絡先にそのまま書けばよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所と四桁の会社内線を用意し、そのまま連絡先に書けばよいと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the new address and phone number. These four digits are my work extension, and I thought I could write them as the contact directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you prepared new address and a four-digit work extension and thought it could be written as the contact unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内線だけの番号と、外から連絡する番号は分けて確認しましょう。ご自身の携帯の番号も変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Separate an extension-only number from one for outside callers. Has your own mobile number changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯は来週変える予定です。今の番号はまだ使えますが、会社の内線を書けば二度変更しなくて済むと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯は来週変更予定で今は使え、内線なら再変更不要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is due to change next week. The current one still works, but I thought using the work extension avoids changing it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the mobile changes next week but works now, and you thought an extension avoids a second change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの番号を登録できるかは担当に確認が必要です。今使える番号と、今後変わる予定を別にお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff must check which number may be registered. Could you explain the usable current number separately from the planned change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の携帯には連絡がつくと伝えます。来週からの新番号はまだ分からないので、予定だけで番号を埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の携帯は使えるが新番号は未定のため、予定だけで番号を記入しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will say the current mobile can be reached. I do not know next week's new number yet, so will not fill a number based only on a plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your current mobile works but the new number is undecided, so you will not fill it just from plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況と、住所変更の希望を一緒に引き継ぎます。通知の送付先についても、確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will pass that situation with the address-change request. Anything to check about notification destinations too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。電話の変更予定とは別に、新住所へ通知が届くようにする相談をしたいです。いつ反映されるかも担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話予定とは別に新住所への通知先と反映時期を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Separately from the phone plan, I want advice on making notifications reach the new address. I will ask staff when it takes effect too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a separate inquiry from the phone plan about notifications to the new address and effective timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所、今の電話、今後の予定、通知先の質問という内容ですね。メモの内線には、その種類が分かるように書き添えておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: So address, current phone, future plan and notification questions. Can you label the extension in the note so its type is clear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内線と書き添え、私用の携帯と混ぜないようにします。今使える連絡先と変更予定を説明してから、登録の進め方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモに内線と注記し私用携帯と区別して、今の連絡先と予定を説明後に登録方法を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write extension and keep it separate from my private mobile. After explaining the current contact and planned change, I will check how to proceed with registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Label the note extension, distinguish your private mobile, explain current contact and plans, then check the registration method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号の種類と時点を分けて伺えるようになりましたね。こちらの担当にメモを示し、ご本人の登録内容と手続きをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The number types and time points are now separate. Show the note to this staff member and discuss your registration details and procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ゼリーを見比べていらっしゃいますね。どんな物をお選びになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing jellies. What kind would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 果物の粒が入った物が好きです。このりんごの写真なら、中にも切ったりんごがあると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 果物の粒入りが好みで、りんご写真から切った果肉も入ると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like pieces of fruit. With this apple photo, I thought it contained cut apple pieces too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you prefer fruit pieces and thought the apple photo meant cut fruit was included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真だけで中の形までは決めず、表示を見ましょう。ここには原材料としてりんご果汁とありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not decide the contents' shape from the photo alone; check the label. It says apple juice as an ingredient here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 果汁という文字は分かりますが、それだけでは果肉の粒が入るかまでは分からないのですね。食感も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 果汁表示は読めるが果肉粒の有無は分からず、食感も確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read juice, but that alone does not tell me whether fruit pieces are included. I want to check texture too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can read juice but cannot tell whether fruit pieces are included, and want to check texture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この面だけでは粒の有無を確認できません。中身の説明がほかにあるか、担当にも確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This side alone does not confirm pieces. Let us ask staff whether there is another contents explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 粒があることを条件に選びたいので、分かるまでこの品は決めません。写真の印象だけで二つとも買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 粒入りを条件とし、分かるまで選ばず写真だけで二品とも買うのをやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pieces are a condition for my choice, so I will not choose this until known. I will not buy both products based only on the pictures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make pieces a condition, wait until confirmed to choose, and stop buying both based on photos alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず一品ずつ条件を確かめましょう。お持ち帰り後は、どのように保存する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: First check conditions one product at a time. How do you plan to store them after taking home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の冷蔵庫に入れるつもりです。ただ、開ける前と開けた後の表示を同じに考えず、この品の欄を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷蔵庫での保存予定を伝え、開封前後を一緒にせず当該表示を読みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: In my refrigerator. But I want to read this product's section without treating before and after opening as the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan refrigerator storage but want this product's instructions without combining unopened and opened conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存の条件はこちらです。粒の有無の確認と、保存方法の読取りは別に確かめておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Storage conditions are here. Check fruit pieces separately from reading the storage method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存の欄は控えました。中身の形はまだ確認中なので、担当の回答を聞いてから、好みに合う品を一つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存欄は控えたが中身の形は確認中なので、担当の回答後に好みの一品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted the storage section. The contents' shape is still being checked, so I will choose one matching my taste after staff answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say storage is noted but contents' shape remains unconfirmed, so choose one preferred item after staff answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望は果肉の粒がある品を一つですね。確認できる説明を調べてご案内しますので、ゼリーはこちらに置いたまま少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You want one with fruit pieces. We will look for an explanation we can verify; leave the jelly here and wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 周回の案内をお探しですね。今日はどなたと歩くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for a circuit walk. Who will you walk with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と短く一周したいです。地図で一番短いこの線を選ぼうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と短い一周を希望し、地図の最短線を選ぶつもりと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a short circuit with a friend. I plan to choose this shortest line on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a short circuit with a friend and plan to choose the map's shortest line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この線には階段の印があります。同行する方の移動で、先に確かめたい条件はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This line has a stairs mark. Any conditions of your companion's movement to check first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は子どものベビーカーを使うそうです。自分が歩くことだけで考え、階段の表示を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は子どものベビーカーを使い、自分の歩行だけ考えて階段印を見落としたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend says they will use their child's stroller. I thought only of myself walking and overlooked the stairs mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your friend uses a child's stroller and you overlooked stairs while considering only your own walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベビーカーも含むご相談として経路を考えましょう。階段を通らない候補も、現地の通行案内と合わせて確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Consider the route including the stroller. Even alternatives without stairs need checking against on-site passage guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一番短い線は選びません。少し長くても階段のない候補を友人と比べたいので、図で違いを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最短線を選ばず、長くても階段のない候補を友人と比べたいので図の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not choose the shortest line. I want to compare stair-free options with my friend even if longer, so show the differences on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not choose shortest; ask map differences to compare longer but stair-free alternatives with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは階段の印を通らない線として描かれています。ただし、図だけで今日の通りやすさまでは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is drawn as a line avoiding the stairs mark. But the diagram alone cannot establish today's ease of passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その線も決定ではなく候補なのですね。友人にベビーカーで行く前提を共有し、入口の係員にも今日の案内を尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別線も未確定候補と理解し、友人と条件を共有して入口係員へ当日の案内を尋ねたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is still a candidate, not decided. I want to share the stroller requirement with my friend and ask entrance staff about today's guidance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the other line is unconfirmed, share conditions with your friend and ask entrance staff for today's guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人で同じ条件を伝えて相談なさってください。周回にこだわらず、確認できた範囲に変更する案も残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consult using the same conditions together. Will you also keep an option of changing to the confirmed area rather than insisting on a circuit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一周できると先に約束せず、友人と確認できた範囲だけ歩く案も残します。戻る入口も一緒に決めてから出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一周を約束せず確認済み範囲だけの案も残し、友人と戻る入口を決めてから出発すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not promise a full circuit first; we will keep an option to walk only the area confirmed together. We will decide the return entrance before departing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not promise a circuit; keep a confirmed-area-only option and decide the return entrance with your friend before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同行者の条件を含めて予定を見直せましたね。案内図をお持ちになり、入口の係員とご相談のうえ、歩く範囲をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You revised the plan with your companion's conditions. Take the map and choose your walking area after consulting entrance staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その扉の前でお困りですか。どちらへ向かいたいか伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at that door? Where would you like to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この乗車案内のホームへ行きたいです。荷物が大きいので、近くの広い扉からエレベーターへ行けるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな荷物で指定ホームへ行くため近い広扉から昇降機へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The platform on this boarding guide. My luggage is large, so I want to ask whether this nearby wide door leads to the elevator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask if the nearby wide door reaches the elevator for the indicated platform with your large luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その扉には職員用と書かれています。幅が広くても利用者用の経路ではありません。まだ入らず、案内図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That door says staff only. Even wide, it is not a passenger route. Do not enter yet; let us check the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅だけで選ばず、ここからは入りません。利用者が通る改札と、そこから階段を避ける道を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 扉幅だけで選ばず職員用へ入らず利用者改札と階段回避路を示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not choose by width or enter here. Please show the passenger ticket gate and a route avoiding stairs from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not choose by width or enter staff-only space; ask to see the passenger gate and stair-avoiding route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在地は改札の外です。こちらの利用者用の改札から先の経路を確認します。荷物を持って曲がる場所の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We are outside the gates. We will check the route beyond this passenger gate. Need an explanation of turning places while carrying luggage too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要です。横向きにすると荷物が当たりそうなので、狭そうな所へ自分で進まず、通り方を係員に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を横にすると当たりそうなので狭い所へ自己進入せず係員へ通り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Turned sideways, my luggage may hit things, so I will not go into narrow-looking places myself; I want to ask staff how to pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say sideways luggage may hit things and ask staff how to pass rather than enter narrow places on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 幅や設備の利用状況を係員に確認します。この図だけで通れると約束するものではありません。確認までどちらで待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask staff about width and equipment availability. This diagram alone is no promise you can pass. Where can you wait until checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 扉や改札の出入りを塞がない、この案内板の横で待ちます。荷物だけ先に中へ置いたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出入りを塞がない案内板横で荷物と待ち荷物だけ中へ置かないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside this information board, not blocking the door or gates. I will not put just the luggage inside ahead of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait with luggage beside the board without blocking entrances, and say you will not put luggage inside first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員がお客様と荷物を見てご案内します。ホームへ行く前に、乗車案内と行き先も照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will guide you after seeing you and the luggage. Before the platform, compare boarding guidance with destination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板の横で荷物と一緒に待ちます。係員に改札からの経路と乗車案内を確認し、職員用の扉を近道にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物と待って係員に改札経路と乗車案内を照合し職員扉を近道にしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait beside the board with my luggage. I will check gate route and boarding guidance with staff, not use the staff door as a shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait with luggage, check gate route and boarding guidance with staff, and do not shortcut through the staff door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではこちらへ係員をお呼びします。確認が済むまで扉へ入らずお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will call a staff member here. Wait without entering the door until checks finish. Take care.
